summary: Disqualification of cooperative society members for not meeting eligibility criteria; bye-law requires minimum sugarcane cultivation area; natural justice breach: Committee report not shared; omnibus show cause notice; failure to disclose material to affected members; concurrent findings on eligibility; High Court upheld disqualification; standard of individual enquiry mandated; impugned judgment set aside.
legal_provisions_cited: Article 226 of the Constitution of India
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; High Court judgment set aside; remand for individual verification of eligibility; disclosure of Committee report mandated.
